name: Festival Stone of Wintersebb
title: Festival Stone of Wintersebb
summary: One of the Empyrean Festival Stones, 'on a rise east of Qalaba'r' (Alatar Locke). In the kit the stone and its Anniversary glow stand on the top of a grassy knoll (z 131) between two 5.5 m black weathered Empyrean columns, a 24 m tree just west; the Qalaba'r Festival Grounds lie 90 m east and 23 m lower.

shots.standingOrder: From knee height 10 m east-south-east look up at the glowing Wintersebb stone between its two black Empyrean columns against the morning sky, easing 0.8 m closer; keep 4 m from the columns, the tree crown behind may be faded.
shots.notes: Low-angle hero of the Wintersebb Festival Stone on its knoll above the Qalaba'r Festival Grounds: the lens sits at knee height on the east slope, so the stone, its Anniversary glow and the two 5.5 m black Empyrean columns that flank it stand against the morning sky; the low ESE sun is behind the lens and lights their faces, and the 24 m tree 10 m behind the stone fills the frame edge.
